views.caption: Parts List

views.name: Parts List (Cont.)
views.caption: Parts List (Cont.)

views.name: Step 1
views.caption: Peel the protective backing off the bottom of the breadboard.

views.name: Step 1c
views.caption: Peel the protective backing off the bottom of the breadboard.

views.name: Step 2
views.caption: Press the breadboard, sticky side down, onto D1 between its corner marks.

views.name: Step 2c
views.caption: Press the breadboard, sticky side down, onto D1 between its corner marks.

views.name: Step 3
views.caption: Press the Nano Board into the breadboard: its pins in rows c and g, from column 2 to column 16, with its USB socket at column 16.

views.name: Step 3c
views.caption: Press the Nano Board into the breadboard: its pins in rows c and g, from column 2 to column 16, with its USB socket at column 16.

views.name: Step 4
views.caption: Bend both legs of the 12 kΩ resistor (brown, red, black, red, brown) straight down.

views.name: Step 4c
views.caption: Bend both legs of the 12 kΩ resistor (brown, red, black, red, brown) straight down.

views.name: Step 5
views.caption: Push the 12 kΩ resistor into h3 and h16.

views.name: Step 5c
views.caption: Push the 12 kΩ resistor into h3 and h16.

views.name: Step 6
views.caption: The capacitor has a negative (-) leg and a positive (+) leg. The grey stripe down its side marks the negative leg, which goes to GND.

inset.alt: A capacitor: the grey strip down its side is over the GND (-) leg; the other leg is VCC (+)
inset.caption: The grey stripe marks the GND (-) leg

views.name: Step 7
views.caption: Push the capacitor into j2 and j3, its grey stripe in j3.
views.caution: The capacitor's grey stripe marks its negative (-) leg, which goes in j3 (the Nano Board's GND).

views.name: Step 7c
views.caption: Push the capacitor into j2 and j3, its grey stripe in j3.
views.caution: The capacitor's grey stripe marks its negative (-) leg, which goes in j3 (the Nano Board's GND).

views.name: Step 8
views.caption: Bend both legs of the 330 Ω resistor (orange, orange, black, black, brown) straight down.

views.name: Step 8c
views.caption: Bend both legs of the 330 Ω resistor (orange, orange, black, black, brown) straight down.

views.name: Step 9
views.caption: Push the 330 Ω resistor into a11 and a19.

views.name: Step 9c
views.caption: Push the 330 Ω resistor into a11 and a19.

views.name: Step 10
views.caption: Pull apart both ends of the three-wire jumper ribbon, so that each wire can reach its own place.

views.name: Step 10c
views.caption: Pull apart both ends of the three-wire jumper ribbon, so that each wire can reach its own place.

views.name: Step 11
views.caption: Push the yellow wire's pin into i2.

views.name: Step 11c
views.caption: Push the yellow wire's pin into i2.

views.name: Step 12
views.caption: Push the grey wire's pin into i3.

views.name: Step 12c
views.caption: Push the grey wire's pin into i3.

views.name: Step 13
views.caption: Push the purple wire's pin into b19.

views.name: Step 13c
views.caption: Push the purple wire's pin into b19.

views.name: Step 14
views.caption: Find the three pins on the back of the LED matrix, at one corner: V+, IN and V-, named on the label beside them. The yellow wire goes on V+, the purple wire on IN and the grey wire on V-.

inset.alt: Close-up of the three pins and the label
inset.caption: V+, IN and V-, as the label names them

views.name: Step 15
views.caption: Push the yellow wire's socket onto the V+ pin of the LED matrix.

views.name: Step 15c
views.caption: Push the yellow wire's socket onto the V+ pin of the LED matrix.

views.name: Step 16
views.caption: Push the purple wire's socket onto the IN pin of the LED matrix.

views.name: Step 16c
views.caption: Push the purple wire's socket onto the IN pin of the LED matrix.

views.name: Step 17
views.caption: Push the grey wire's socket onto the V- pin of the LED matrix.

views.name: Step 17c
views.caption: Push the grey wire's socket onto the V- pin of the LED matrix.

views.name: Step 18
views.caption: Unscrew the nut from the push button and slide it off over the wires.

views.name: Step 18c
views.caption: Unscrew the nut from the push button and slide it off over the wires.

views.name: Step 19
views.caption: Push the button, wires first, through the round hole in D2 from the side with D2 engraved on it.

views.name: Step 19c
views.caption: Push the button, wires first, through the round hole in D2 from the side with D2 engraved on it.

views.name: Step 20
views.caption: Screw the nut back onto the button from the other side of D2, until it is tight against D2.

views.name: Step 20c
views.caption: Screw the nut back onto the button from the other side of D2, until it is tight against D2.

views.name: Step 21
views.caption: Push the pin on the button's red wire into j5.

views.name: Step 21c
views.caption: Push the pin on the button's red wire into j5.

views.name: Step 22
views.caption: Push the pin on the button's black wire into j16.

views.name: Step 22c
views.caption: Push the pin on the button's black wire into j16.

views.name: Step 23
views.caption: Plug the USB cable's Mini-B plug into the Nano Board's USB socket, its cable towards the D4 end of the base.

views.name: Step 23c
views.caption: Plug the USB cable's Mini-B plug into the Nano Board's USB socket, its cable towards the D4 end of the base.

views.name: Step 24
views.caption: Stand D2, with the button, on D1: its tabs go into the slots along the edge of D1.

views.name: Step 24c
views.caption: Stand D2, with the button, on D1: its tabs go into the slots along the edge of D1.

views.name: Step 25
views.caption: Lower D4 beside the end of D1, the USB cable in the notch at its foot, then push it onto the tabs of D1 and D2.

views.name: Step 25c
views.caption: Lower D4 beside the end of D1, the USB cable in the notch at its foot, then push it onto the tabs of D1 and D2.

views.name: Step 26
views.caption: Lift the LED matrix over D4, turning it round, and lay it down outside, LEDs up, its wires over the top edge of D4.

views.name: Step 26c
views.caption: Lift the LED matrix over D4, turning it round, and lay it down outside, LEDs up, its wires over the top edge of D4.

views.name: Step 27
views.caption: Turn the box over. Hook the tabs at the end of D3 into the slots in D4, then swing D3 shut onto D1.

views.name: Step 27c
views.caption: Turn the box over. Hook the tabs at the end of D3 into the slots in D4, then swing D3 shut onto D1.

views.name: Step 28
views.caption: Push D5 onto the open end, over the tabs of D1, D2 and D3.

views.name: Step 28c
views.caption: Push D5 onto the open end, over the tabs of D1, D2 and D3.

views.name: Step 29
views.caption: Turn the box the right way up. Push the two D9 LED supports down into their slots in D2 and D3.

views.name: Step 29c
views.caption: Turn the box the right way up. Push the two D9 LED supports down into their slots in D2 and D3.

views.name: Step 30
views.caption: Pick up the LED matrix and hold it over the box, LEDs up.

views.name: Step 30c
views.caption: Pick up the LED matrix and hold it over the box, LEDs up.

views.name: Step 31
views.caption: Hook D10 under the LED matrix: hold it under the matrix, then slide it along until its hooks hold both edges.

views.name: Step 31c
views.caption: Hook D10 under the LED matrix: hold it under the matrix, then slide it along until its hooks hold both edges.

views.name: Step 32
views.caption: Lower the LED matrix, with D10, into the box: the ends of D10 go into the slots in D4 and D5.

views.name: Step 32c

inset.alt: Close-up of the end of D10, the LED matrix and D4 faint: the three wires go down through its slot
inset.caption: The wires lie in the slot in D10

views.caption: Lower the LED matrix, with D10, into the box: the ends of D10 go into the slots in D4 and D5.

views.name: Step 33
views.caption: Lay D6 on top of the walls, its slots over their tabs.

views.name: Step 33c

inset.alt: The box from above, without D6: four red boxes round the slots in D1
inset.caption: The four slots in D1 for the D11 posts

views.caption: Lay D6 on top of the walls, its slots over their tabs.

views.name: Step 34
views.caption: Push two D11 shelf posts down through the corner slots of D6 at the D5 end, until their tabs reach the slots in D1.

views.name: Step 34c
views.caption: Push two D11 shelf posts down through the corner slots of D6 at the D5 end, until their tabs reach the slots in D1.

views.name: Step 35
views.caption: Push the other two D11 posts down through the corner slots at the D4 end, until their tabs reach the slots in D1.

views.name: Step 35c
views.caption: Push the other two D11 posts down through the corner slots at the D4 end, until their tabs reach the slots in D1.

views.name: Step 36
views.caption: Turn the box over. Push all four D11 posts down until their tabs come through the slots in D1.

views.name: Step 36c

inset.alt: Close-up from below of a D11 tab through its slot in D1
inset.caption: The tab through D1

views.caption: Turn the box over. Push all four D11 posts down until their tabs come through the slots in D1.

views.name: Step 37
views.caption: Turn the box the right way up. Lay D7 onto the D11 posts.

views.name: Step 37c
views.caption: Turn the box the right way up. Lay D7 onto the D11 posts.

views.name: Step 38
views.caption: Lay D8 onto the D11 posts.

views.name: Step 38c
views.caption: Lay D8 onto the D11 posts.

views.name: Step 39
views.caption: Push one LED stem down through a corner hole of D8, D7 and D6 until it stands over its LED.

views.name: Step 39c
views.caption: Push one LED stem down through a corner hole of D8, D7 and D6 until it stands over its LED.

views.name: Step 40
views.caption: Push in the other 63 LED stems the same way, one through each hole.

views.name: Step 40c
views.caption: Push in the other 63 LED stems the same way, one through each hole.
